name: caption-speaker
title: Caption Speaker
description: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's color, so a conversation reads like a script.
useWhen: An interview, podcast clip or two-person demo where the viewer has to know who is talking without seeing their mouth.
Your transcript already has speaker labels from diarization and you want them to carry through to the screen.
avoidWhen: Only one person speaks: use caption-karaoke, which spends the color on the voice's progress instead.
You want plain, neutral subtitles for an explainer: use caption-subtitle.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Speaker colors
variables.description: JSON object mapping a speaker label to a color, for example {"host":"#38bdf8"}. Unlisted speakers get colors automatically.

variables.label: Upcoming opacity
variables.description: Opacity of words that have not been spoken yet.
